en.title: Every Year After Season 2: Prime Video Hints at Romantic Drama's Return
en.summary: The romantic drama 'Every Year After' has Prime Video fans buzzing about a potential second season. While an official green light is pending, hints from the streamer suggest the love story of Percy and Sam might continue.
en.body:
Prime Video is keeping the door open for more heartfelt moments in Barry's Bay. While an official Season 2 renewal for **Every Year After** is still on the horizon, the streamer is clearly leaning towards continuing the adaptation of Carley Fortune's bestselling novel, *Every Summer After*. The first season, which dropped all eight episodes on June 10, 2026, immediately captured the attention of viewers drawn to the nostalgic, coming-of-age romance.

Sources close to the production and statements from Amazon MGM Studios executives indicate a strong likelihood of the series returning. Peter Friedlander, Head of TV at Amazon MGM Studios, has hinted at upcoming renewals during industry events, fueling speculation that **Every Year After** is high on the list. The creative team behind the show has also expressed ambitions to extend the narrative beyond the confines of the first book, suggesting that future seasons could explore new storylines or delve deeper into the characters' lives, potentially drawing from other works or original material.

## A Story That Resonates

The decision to potentially renew **Every Year After** for a second season speaks volumes about its impact on the audience. The series, much like its literary inspiration, taps into a potent blend of first love, summer nostalgia, and the complexities of growing up. This resonated deeply with viewers, many of whom have drawn comparisons to other popular YA adaptations like *The Summer I Turned Pretty*. The immediate binge-release format of Season 1 allowed fans to fully immerse themselves in the world of Percy and Sam, creating a dedicated fanbase eager for more.

## What Fans Are Hoping For

The fan anticipation for Season 2 is palpable. Many viewers took to social media following the Season 1 finale, expressing their desire for the story to continue. The open-ended nature of the first season, coupled with the creative team's hints about future possibilities, has created a significant curiosity gap. Fans are eager to see how the characters will evolve, what new challenges they might face, and whether the show will continue to capture the emotional depth that made the first season a success. The strong reception of the first season suggests that Prime Video recognizes the potential for **Every Year After** to become a staple in its romantic drama lineup.

What's Next

While official confirmation and release dates for **Every Year After** Season 2 have not yet been announced, the positive signals from Prime Video and the creative team suggest that fans should keep a close watch. The streamer is expected to make a formal announcement in the coming months, with production likely to commence once details are finalized.
